people/groups/tsumitobatsu/members/orihi.heading: ## Character Setting and Anecdotes
people/groups/tsumitobatsu/members/orihi.body:
| Item | Detail |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Name** | Orihime (御莉姫) |
| **Aliases** | 織姫 (the kanji spelling the name originally corresponds to; unofficial), Princess |
| **Eyes / Hair** | Yellow eyes / pink hair |
| **Signature traits** | Headband, gap moe |
| **Affiliation** | [SINSEIKI](/database/artists/groups/sinseiki) (XTuber unit) |

**Known anecdotes**

- **The height gap**: her music and singing have been called those of a “next-generation virtual dark singer”, yet she revealed on stream that she stands barely over 140 cm — the shortest in SINSEIKI (though not the shortest in the Girls Revolution Project as a whole).
- **Contrast with VALIS**: Orihime and Kakyoin once remarked that “next to the VALIS members we look tiny...”
- **Daily rhythm**: she sleeps at seven in the morning and wakes at ten; her schedule is said to resemble [HARUSARUHI](/database/artists/vwp/harusaruhi)'s.
- **How to read the name**: because 「御」 can be read either *go* or *o*, she made a point in her first stream of saying the correct reading is “**o**rihime”, not “gori (gorilla) hime”.
- **Horror-game resistance**: her tolerance for horror games is very high — even a sudden jump scare draws no sound at all — {{spoiler::though she is afraid of all kinds of insects, shrimp included.}}
- **Interaction with a senior**: after covering “亡国のネメシス” with [ISEKAIJOUCHO](/database/artists/vwp/isekaijoucho), she wrote a very long message of thanks on X, calling her “my beloved ISEKAIJOUCHO-senpai”; ISEKAIJOUCHO replied at length, writing that “Orihime-chan's singing is so lovely... it felt like the two of us were making a story together.”

> **Role within the project**: Orihime was one of the first in the Girls Revolution Project to run streams and release solo songs (her first stream was on 17 December 2024). That contrast between a cute appearance and a dark vocal is precisely the core appeal of the *Shin* side of the project.

**Unit and duet songs (selection)**

- “Mabataki” (Orihime × Yunagi, 2025-02-19; words, music and arrangement by Kinoshita Ryūhei).
- SINSEIKI unit songs including “Fake Night Cinderella”, “Perfection”, “Ephemeral”, “Kokoroto”, “Usonaki”, “Million Complexity” and “Zatsukichou”.
- Appearances at major shows including the Girls Revolution Project 1st LIVE “Kaihen” and 2nd LIVE “Revolutio”.

> **Musical character**: Orihime's solo songs are supplied by composers with strongly contrasting styles — wotaku, Hitogoto, Ren and Hirata Yoshihisa — spanning electro-pop, dark rock and Japanese-style balladry, making her the widest-ranging member on the *Shin* side.
